titulo_es: Choose between verbal and nominal forms

Beslutet fattades efter samråd.es: La decisión se tomó tras una consulta
Beslutet fattades efter samråd.en: The decision was made after a consultation

texto: Choose impersonal and nominal forms when summarizing procedures. **Beslutet fattades efter samråd** means «The decision was made after a consultation». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
